examples.arabic: هو نصحني امشي مع القطه بتاعته
examples.english: He advised me to walk with his cat.
examples.transliteration: howa nasahni amshi maa el otta betato

examples.arabic: اخويا بياكل بسرعه اوي زي القطه
examples.english: My brother is eating very fast like a cat.
examples.transliteration: akhooya beyakol besoraa awi zay el ota

examples.english: We saw the cat eating the chicken.
examples.transliteration: Shofna el otta betakol el ferakh

examples.arabic: قطة صغيرة هنا هي عايزة اكل
examples.english: A small cat is here, she wants food!
examples.transliteration: Otta soghayyara hena heya ayza akel!

examples.arabic: ليه السما زرقا يا ماما وليه القطة بتنام على الكنبة
examples.english: Why is the sky blue, Mom, and why does the cat sleep on the sofa?
examples.transliteration: Leh el-sama zar2a ya Mama we leh el-2otta betnam 3ala el-kanaba?

examples.arabic: وصلنا قسم الفاكهة والخضار وفجأة امي قالت نسيت اقولك الهدوم دي كانت للقطة بتاعتنا
examples.english: We reached the fruit and vegetable section, and suddenly my mother said, "I forgot to tell you, these clothes were for our cat!"
examples.transliteration: Wasalna 'esm el fakha wel khodaar, we faga'a ommy 'alet: "Neseet a'ollak, el hedoom di kanet lel 'otta beta'tna!"
